visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses and a black bucket hat leans toward a professional microphone under a white tent; he wears a white t-shirt with a 'TONY STAN' graphic. Beside him is another young man with sunglasses. (2) The scene shifts to an interior view of the tent with a floor fan, a laptop on a table, and two men sitting; they engage in a lively conversation with expressive hand gestures. (3) The man with glasses holds up a blue nitrile glove and points toward the camera in an urban plaza setting with buildings and trees in the background. (4) The two main characters stand in a large paved city square; they wear identical white 'TONY STAN' t-shirts and appear to be mock-arguing while looking at each other. (5) A close-up shot shows a hand in a blue glove using a spray can to create pink and orange graffiti on a blue plastic sheet stretched across a frame. (6) Three men gather around a white Akai MPC sampler on a wooden table, with one man tapping the pads to create a rhythm. (7) One man holds a blue box containing several gold-colored bracelets with local Taiwanese themed charms, showing them to the camera while standing outdoors. (8) A large banner for 'SCHOOL OF THE STREET' appears, followed by a wide shot of a crowded outdoor performance area with a stage. (9) A man in sunglasses and the same 'TONY STAN' shirt performs on stage, holding a microphone and gesturing with his free hand. (10) A young woman in purple overalls and a white t-shirt joins him on stage, singing into a microphone with high energy. (11) A high-angle shot shows a large building with a vertical green banner that reads 'SCHOOL OF THE STREET' and promotional text for an upcoming event.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotional vlog for the '2025 New Taipei School of the Street'. It uses humorous interactions between two popular hosts to engage the audience before transitioning into a dynamic showcase of street culture elements like graffiti and music production, culminating in a live performance to build excitement for the event.
